title: coleus niamniamensis
intro: Coleus niamniamensis, commonly known as the Niamniambo leaf or Coleus niamniamensis, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central Africa. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate conditions like fever, malaria, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Coleus niamniamensis include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
